components.name: SiteHeader
components.doc: A website header in three layouts. It sticks to the top and turns solid once the page scrolls, marks the current section with an indicator that glides between links, opens springy mega menu panels whose content slides in from the side you moved toward, and folds into a menu sheet on narrow containers.

components.name: SiteHeaderBlock
components.doc: Preview: the header inside a small scrolling page, with a switch between its three layouts.

types.name: SiteHeaderLink
types.doc: One destination inside a mega menu panel.

members.name: description
members.doc: One short line under the label.

members.name: icon
members.doc: A plain decorative icon beside the label.

types.name: SiteHeaderFeature
types.doc: A card beside the links in a mega menu panel.

types.name: SiteHeaderItem
types.doc: A top level destination. With `links` and the mega variant it opens a panel; otherwise it is a plain link.

members.name: section
members.doc: The top level item the destination belongs to.

members.name: variant
members.doc: `simple` puts links beside the brand, `centered` centers them in a quiet capsule, `mega` opens panels for items with links.

members.name: brand
members.type: { name: string; href?: string; mark?: ReactNode }

members.name: current
members.doc: Value of the item that holds the current page (controlled).

members.name: onCurrentChange
members.doc: Called when a destination inside an item is chosen, with that item's value.

members.name: onNavigate
members.doc: Called for every destination: items, panel links, the brand, and actions with an href.

members.name: secondaryAction
members.doc: A quiet action before the primary one, such as Sign in. Pass null to hide it.

members.name: primaryAction
members.doc: The one primary action at the end of the bar. Pass null to hide it.

members.name: sticky
members.doc: Sticks to the top of its scroll container. Defaults to true.

members.name: scrollContainer
members.doc: The element that scrolls, when it is not the window. The header turns solid once it scrolls.

members.name: scrollThreshold
members.doc: Pixels of scroll before the background turns solid. Defaults to 8.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

members.name: defaultOpenItem
members.doc: Mega variant: the item whose panel starts open, as a preview would show it. It closes like any panel (outside press, Escape) and never moves focus on its own.

types.name: DestinationProps
types.text: Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, "onClick" | "children"> & { link: { href?: string; label: string }; onChoose: (event: ReactMouseEvent) => void; children: ReactNode }
